No concrete removal, reconstructed hidden area, shifted opening, rewritten inscription or added luminance texture was found in the reviewed views. Colour boundaries follow the visible main surfaces closely enough for a provisional COLOR_ONLY visual vote.

Courtyard wall and apertures, fabric in lower window, shed roof frame and cloth, broken walls, foliage, debris and foreground paving remain present. Original dimensions and archive frame are retained.
No legible inscription is newly established; source marks and fabric remain at the source's level of detail.

Pale ochre/brown-gray plaster, reddish exposed masonry, brown timber, gray metal and green vegetation are readable without a global sepia/gray wash. Colours remain model_hypothesis/provisional/unlocked. This positive vote is visual only; identity remains pending and upload is held.

Matched dimensions and very close grayscale structure support the visual preservation findings but are not a visual pass or proof of historical colours. Chroma-only material patterns must be judged in colour.
